summary: Deliverable is incomplete and non-functional. Workflow references PrLabelAssigner.Tests.ps1, Workflow.Tests.ps1, .actrc, and fixture files (fixtures/config.json, fixtures/changed-files.json) that are not provided. Run-ActTests.ps1 will fail at Copy-Item (line 239) when attempting to copy missing test files. Main script PrLabelAssigner.ps1 is well-written (Set-StrictMode, error handling, clear docs) but JSON parsing logic duplicated (lines 215–246). Workflow lacks validation that required files exist before attempting Invoke-Pester. No error handling for missing fixture paths in workflow env vars.
